blocks.content:
Judges of the Supreme Court are appointed by the President of India.

Collegium System:
• The Chief Justice of India and senior judges recommend names.
• Ensures judicial independence.

This system evolved through Supreme Court judgments.
Judges of the Supreme Court are appointed by the President of India.

items: Supreme Court judges are appointed by the President of India, not by Parliament.
The Collegium System consists of the Chief Justice of India and senior judges.
The Collegium System is a creation of Supreme Court judgments, not an original constitutional provision.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Judges of the Supreme Court are formally appointed by the President of India.
The Collegium System consists of the Chief Justice of India and senior judges who recommend names for appointment.
The primary purpose of the Collegium System is to ensure judicial independence.
The Collegium System evolved through key Supreme Court judgments over time.
